synopsis: Linde states that Reverse Assist Radar slows forklifts while reversing and can bring them to a complete stop; the glossary repeats the slowing and stopping capability [f1408, f1681, f15787]. The system uses radar and offers an optional AI camera recognizing work and protective clothing [f1682, f15787]. The research found no validation methods, validation evidence, independent evaluations or information on field problems, so the reported capabilities are not independently substantiated by the supplied corpus [f1410, f1684, f1685, f15788]. Published limits and exclusions and a launch date were also not found, leaving operating boundaries and product timing unresolved [f1683, f1680].
